posts.title: Three injuries. One founder who never gave up.
posts.caption:
Three injuries. One founder who never gave up.
Wahab Zafar was born in rural Jhang. Three serious injuries could not stop him. He built the PRIMEPIPFX Command Center and the Prime Pip SBT Indicator, and more features are coming.
Read his full story: https://primepipfx.site/about.html
